results.content: Reproducibility of Human Data Collection for Machine Learning Models Much of current Machine Learning (ML) is based on human data (i.e. supervised learning, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)) and the performance of even very Large Language Models (LLMs) is highly reliant on the quality of the collected data. The project involves human data collection and analysis, and also implementation and reassessment of state of the art ML models’ performance.
